decisions.reason: As a multi-variant organic flagship central to the firm's announced organic expansion, it carries heavy public and strategic commitment, so management would attribute any weak early results to market ramp-up and persist.
The organic poultry snack fits the announced organic direction and has its own dedicated web page, signalling visible commitment, though as a single niche item it is somewhat more expendable.
The premium sharing salami line sits close to the core salami competence, has several variants and its own web page, so sunk investment and visibility favour keeping it.
